Networking & Security: The Python MT5 Live Copilot (e.g., mt5_live_copilot_v1.99_beta.py) MUST be bound to 127.0.0.1 for ports 5555 and 5556 to prevent external exposure.

WINE Network Limitations: The MT5 EA MUST have a SocketConnect timeout of at least 2000ms during initialization because WINE's TCP stack requires time to construct the initial sockets under load. Short timeouts (1-50ms) will fail silently.

MT5 Terminal Permissions: The MT5 Terminal must have 'Allow DLL imports' and 'Allow WebRequest' enabled in Tools -> Options -> Expert Advisors, and the WebRequestUrl must contain http://127.0.0.1 and http://localhost. Otherwise SocketConnect fails with error 4014 (ERR_FUNCTION_NOT_ALLOWED). This can also be forced by editing Config/common.ini.

Start by using the RAG database to query the correct lightweight-charts-python initialization sequence for handling DataFrames with historical data alongside subcharts.

To successfully load history into lightweight-charts-python and subcharts avoiding 'Cannot read property series of undefined': both main chart and all subchart line series MUST be initialized with dataframes of the exact same length and same identical 'time' column. Use `df_dummy = pd.DataFrame({'time': times, 'value_key': [0.0]*len(times)})` for the subcharts, then assign real tick data via `.iloc[-1]` for the current active tick before calling `.set(df_dummy)` on the subchart elements.
